script_text: Pisces, Neptune warns: stop ignoring that quiet inner voice screaming at you today. Monday through Wednesday feels heavy for your sensitive soul. Your Water element clashes with Libra’s Sun opposing you in your seventh house of partnership. Wednesday is the worst day; Mercury opposes Saturn, creating friction in your hidden and private twelfth house matters. Mid-week, the energy shifts. The Moon trines Venus in your tenth house, easing career pressure. Late week, career money settles as Venus squares Jupiter back to balance, and love truly deepens with honest conversation. Your weekend brings relief from months of silent stress. Thursday is your power day because the Moon harmonizes your tenth house of career and public reputation. Wednesday is your warning day, not a failure, so hold your tongue. Trust your gut, but always write down every financial agreement before signing. Follow for daily updates.
